right:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 4-frame walk-cycle sprite sheet for MashRoom, RIGHT-facing profile.
Input reference 1 is the original front Roomie, identity and painterly style reference. Input reference 2 is the approved RIGHT profile: preserve this exact head, silhouette, hair locks, glasses, skin, body proportions and outfit.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet in a STRICT 2-column by 2-row grid, four equal rectangular cells, portrait 2:3 overall canvas. Cell order row-major: top-left frame 1, top-right frame 2, bottom-left frame 3, bottom-right frame 4.
Each cell contains the exact same full-body RIGHT-facing character at the SAME scale, SAME head location, SAME pelvis location and floor baseline. Keep the head and facial identity identical in every frame. No labels, grid lines or separators. Character isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no shadows or floor.
Animation: a clear looping in-place walk to the RIGHT, four successive phases, NOT four duplicates.
1 CONTACT A: near leg forward to right heel down, far leg behind to left toe down; near arm back and far arm forward.
2 PASSING A: near leg supports torso upright, far leg bent at knee with heel lifted and passing underneath; arms passing near hips.
3 CONTACT B: far leg forward to right heel down, near leg behind to left toe down; near arm forward and far arm back. Swap the legs and arm swing visibly versus frame 1.
4 PASSING B: far leg supports torso upright, near leg bent at knee with heel lifted passing underneath; arms near hips. This naturally loops back to frame 1.
Maintain the reference full-body proportions: huge wavy dark brown curled head with swept top lock, warm peach skin, one big brown eye, gray rounded rectangular glasses, friendly smile and blush, charcoal short-sleeve high-neck tee with white collar emblem, loose pale gray pleated trousers, chunky gray/white trainers with readable black N details. Same warm hand-painted texture, shading and outline. Pose changes must move the arms and legs anatomically, with knee bends and foot lift. All heads, hands and shoes wholly inside their own cell with at least 5% safe margins. No additional character designs, no frontal views, no changing expressions or outfit, no head bouncing between cells.
